raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "cook at"
      role subject ?x
      role location "the Botanical Garden in Tulcea"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Mr Brown"
      polarity negated
    end
  end
